name: SessionTimeoutManager
src_typeComment: Distinct from IdleAttractManager: that one watches the WHOLE kiosk for idle time to trigger an attract screen; this one is scoped to ONE in-progress flow (a form, a checkout) via explicit StartSession()/ EndSession() calls, and warns before resetting rather than resetting silently — the standard public- kiosk "are you still there?" safety net for a flow a user walked away from mid-way through.

src_serialized.name: timeoutDuration
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds of inactivity before the session is auto-reset.

src_serialized.name: warningDuration
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds before the timeout that OnWarning starts firing (a countdown window).

src_members.sig: public bool IsSessionActive { get; private set; }
src_members.name: IsSessionActive
NotifyActivity
src_members.comment: Call on any meaningful user action within the flow (a button press, a text field edit) to push the timeout back out — NOT on every frame, that would defeat the point.

src_members.name: Tick
src_members.comment: Public so a self-test can drive the timeout/warning window with exact time increments without needing Play mode.
